name: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Northfield, MN · host St. Olaf · Tostrud Center
headline: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 4 UW-La Crosse won the women’s race with 32 points, all five scorers in the top 11, ahead of No. 18 Carleton (106) and No. 26 UW-Stevens Point (114), whose Faith Wehrman won in 21:36.4. No. 5 UW-La Crosse also took the men’s title, 52 to 61 over No. 7 UW-Stevens Point, even as Stevens Point’s Mateo Alvarado Venegas (24:27.5) and Logan Murphy went 1-2, a tenth of a second apart.
